title: Multiplication step
statement: For a list state $S$, write its nested pair decomposition as $(A,(B,C))$. If $B$ is empty, the step returns $S$; otherwise it returns the encoding of $(	ext{false} :: A,(	ext{drop}_1(B),R))$, where $R$ is the binary sum of the encoding of $(C,A)$ when the first bit of $B$ is true, and is $C$ when that bit is false. An empty $B$ has default first bit false.
hypotheses_covered: Input state is a list of Booleans
caveat: The supplied statement omits the definitions of the pair encoding, its defaulted projections, and binary addition, so their exact conventions cannot be stated more precisely.
